segments.text: This is the fifth video presentation for the Case Animal and Plant Biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动植物生物技术课程的第五个视频演示。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Plant Cloning Lesson 4.2 Performance Enhanced Plants
segments.zh: 植物克隆，第 4.2 课，性能增强型植物

segments.text: You researched and compared methods of inserting genes into plants during Activity 421, Getting Genes into Plants.
segments.zh: 在活动 4.2.1“让基因进入植物”中，你研究并比较了将基因插入植物的方法。

segments.text: Once plant cells have the desired genes, new plants must be created to express the genes across a population.
segments.zh: 一旦植物细胞拥有了所需的基因，就必须培育出新的植株，使这些基因在整个群体中表达。

segments.text: Tissue culture, or micropopigation, refers to the process by which individual cells are coaxed to develop into a new plant, in vitro means in the test tube.
segments.zh: 组织培养，或称微繁殖，是指诱导单个细胞发育成一株新植物的过程，体外的意思是在试管中。

segments.text: Micropopigation uses a very small amount of plant tissue that may not contain enough nutrients or hormones to support cell multiplication and formation.
segments.zh: 微繁殖使用的植物组织量非常少，其中可能没有足够的营养物质或激素来支持细胞增殖和形成。

segments.text: Augur provides water and nutrients to encourage cell multiplication.
segments.zh: 琼脂提供水分和营养物质，以促进细胞增殖。

segments.text: Once an unorganized group of cells is formed, an augur containing nutrients and oxens is used to force the tissue to develop into specialized structures, including roots and meristematic tissue.
segments.zh: 一旦形成一团未分化的细胞群，就使用含有营养物质和生长素的琼脂，促使组织发育成特化结构，包括根和分生组织。

segments.text: The unorganized group of cells develops into a mass called a callus.
segments.zh: 这团未分化的细胞群会发育成一个被称为愈伤组织的团块。

segments.text: From there, cells will multiply and differentiate into plant tissues and systems.
segments.zh: 从那里开始，细胞会增殖并分化成植物的组织和系统。

segments.text: Any part of the plant can be used if the tissue is living.
segments.zh: 只要组织是活的，植物的任何部位都可以使用。

segments.text: A higher success rate is experienced if young, aggressive growth tissue, such as meristems or new leaves, are used.
segments.zh: 如果使用幼嫩、生长旺盛的组织，比如分生组织或新叶，成功率会更高。

segments.text: Culturing is done from parent plant that has desirable characteristics.
segments.zh: 培养材料取自具有理想性状的母本植株。

segments.text: After taking a cutting from the parent plant, the cutting is prepared for regeneration.
segments.zh: 从母本植株上取下插穗后，要对插穗进行再生前的处理。

segments.text: Clusters of embryos will have to be divided just as we did with the chrysanthemums or grasses in the Principles of Agricultural Science Plant Course.
segments.zh: 胚团需要分开，就像我们在《农业科学原理——植物》课程中处理菊花或禾草时那样。

segments.text: In a sterile environment, the embryos will be transferred to augur containing oxen, which is a rooting hormone.
segments.zh: 在无菌环境中，把胚转移到含有生长素的琼脂上，生长素是一种生根激素。

segments.text: Hormones cause the embryos to develop structures needed for the plant to survive.
segments.zh: 激素促使胚发育出植物生存所需的结构。

segments.text: Roots, shoots, and buds emerge to form young plantlets.
segments.zh: 根、茎和芽长出来，形成幼小的小植株。

segments.text: Still susceptible to disease, young plantlets are grown in controlled environments until they can survive in normal growing conditions.
segments.zh: 幼小的小植株仍然容易染病，因此要在受控环境中培养，直到它们能够在正常生长条件下存活。

segments.text: Certain requirements must be met for optimal growth.
segments.zh: 要实现最佳生长，必须满足某些要求。

segments.text: These essential needs of the plant cells and tissue culture is no different than normal growing plants.
segments.zh: 植物细胞和组织培养的这些基本需求，与正常生长的植物并无不同。

segments.text: The environment is altered to meet the requirements of young, tender cells.
segments.zh: 要改变环境，以满足幼嫩细胞的需求。

segments.text: Advantages to tissue culture make it a great tool for mass propagation of desirable plants.
segments.zh: 组织培养的优点使其成为大规模繁殖优良植物的绝佳工具。

segments.text: In most species, multiplication of plants using the micropropagation is faster than sexual propagation.
segments.zh: 对于大多数物种，用微繁殖法繁殖植物比有性繁殖更快。

segments.text: This process is especially useful when only a small amount of plant material is available for a desirable plant.
segments.zh: 当某种优良植物只有少量植物材料可用时，这个方法尤其有用。

segments.text: Several offspring can be generated from just a few cells.
segments.zh: 仅仅几个细胞就能培育出多个后代。

segments.text: Special equipment and skills are needed to perform tissue culture with great success.
segments.zh: 要成功地进行组织培养，需要特殊的设备和技能。

segments.text: The plants are very vulnerable to injury and death in the early stages of development.
segments.zh: 在发育早期，这些植物非常容易受损和死亡。

segments.text: As a review, marker highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember from this presentation.
segments.zh: 作为复习，请在笔记中标记或突出显示本演示中需要记住的三个要点。

segments.text: List two key ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的关键观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何疑问。

segments.text: Discuss these questions with your instructor.
segments.zh: 与你的老师讨论这些问题。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available for use throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把你在本演示中做的所有笔记整理好，以便在整个课程中随时使用。

segments.text: Through Activity 422, Culturing Ferns, you will propagate ferns using tissue culture and sterile technique
segments.zh: 通过活动 4.2.2“蕨类培养”，你将使用组织培养和无菌技术繁殖蕨类植物，

segments.text: in order to understand that the total potency of plants allows minute proportions of plants to be cultured into a complete plant.
segments.zh: 以理解植物的全能性使得植物极小的一部分就能培养成一株完整的植物。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供更多说明。

segments.text: For more information about sterile technique, view the video presentation titled Stereal Technique for Plant Cloning.
segments.zh: 有关无菌技术的更多信息，请观看题为《植物克隆的无菌技术》的视频演示。
